name: awareness
description: Tells you what is happening and what needs you, without noise: Heads-Up toasts (max 1 a minute, plus long command timer), Now Doing phase band, Spec Tracker and a Focus Timer that silences the toasts.

mod_headsup_enabled.title: Heads-Up
mod_headsup_enabled.description: Toasts for cache, long commands, context, pace, big output, Ollama.

mod_nowdoing_enabled.title: Now Doing
mod_nowdoing_enabled.description: Phase chips, checklist progress and long command timer above the prompt.

mod_spec_enabled.title: Spec Tracker
mod_spec_enabled.description: Count checkboxes of the plan or spec file being edited.

mod_focus_enabled.title: Focus Timer
mod_focus_enabled.description: Pomodoro band segment; Heads-Up stays quiet during focus.

minBandRows.title: Minimum band rows
minBandRows.description: The band stays hidden when fewer rows are free.

mascots.title: Mascots
mascots.description: auto and on draw Pom as an image on the desktop; off draws a block mark.

headsup_minGapMs.title: Toast gap (ms)
headsup_minGapMs.description: Minimum time between two Heads-Up toasts.

headsup_idleSec.title: Idle after (s)
headsup_idleSec.description: No turn and no prompt for this long counts as idle.

headsup_queueTtlMin.title: Queue lifetime (min)
headsup_queueTtlMin.description: A held toast expires after this long.

headsup_digestAfterFocus.title: Digest after focus
headsup_digestAfterFocus.description: One toast after a focus block summarising what was held back.

headsup_trigger_cache.title: Trigger: cache expiry
headsup_trigger_cache.description: Warn before the prompt cache expires.

headsup_trigger_context.title: Trigger: context
headsup_trigger_context.description: Warn when the context window is nearly full.

headsup_trigger_pace.title: Trigger: usage pace
headsup_trigger_pace.description: Warn when the weekly pace turns HOT.

headsup_trigger_bigOutput.title: Trigger: big output
headsup_trigger_bigOutput.description: Warn about a very large tool result.

headsup_trigger_ollama.title: Trigger: Ollama down
headsup_trigger_ollama.description: Warn when the local Ollama is down (needs OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH).

headsup_trigger_noModel.title: Trigger: agent without model
headsup_trigger_noModel.description: Off by default: Delegation Guard owns this toast.

headsup_cache_warnSec.title: Cache warning (s)
headsup_cache_warnSec.description: Warn when this many seconds of cache remain.

headsup_cache_minCtxTokens.title: Cache min context (tokens)
headsup_cache_minCtxTokens.description: No cache warning below this context size.

cache_ttl.title: Cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: auto learns the TTL; 5m or 1h fixes it.

cache_followCacheTax.title: Follow cache-tax TTL
cache_followCacheTax.description: Use the cache-tax plugin's TTL when it is installed.

headsup_longSec.title: Long command (s)
headsup_longSec.description: A foreground command running this long raises a toast.

headsup_context_warnAt.title: Context warning (%)
headsup_context_warnAt.description: Warn when context use crosses this percent.

headsup_bigOutput_kb.title: Big output (KB)
headsup_bigOutput_kb.description: Decimal KB of one tool result.

headsup_noModel_allowTypes.title: No-model allowed types
headsup_noModel_allowTypes.description: Comma-separated globs of agent types that need no model.

nowdoing_mascot.title: Now Doing mascot
nowdoing_mascot.description: Show Pom (20 px) in the Now Doing segment.

nowdoing_showAfterSec.title: Show command timer after (s)
nowdoing_showAfterSec.description: A running command shows in the band after this long.

nowdoing_tool.title: Phase tool
nowdoing_tool.description: Register mcp__awareness__phase so the model can set the phase and a note.

nowdoing_phaseMap.title: Extra tool phases
nowdoing_phaseMap.description: JSON object mapping tool names to research, plan, build, verify or report.

spec_globs.title: Spec file globs
spec_globs.description: Comma-separated globs of plan and spec files to auto-discover.

spec_nested.title: Nested checkboxes
spec_nested.description: all counts nested items; top counts top-level only.

focus_sound.title: Sound
focus_sound.description: chime plays a short tone when a block ends (macOS).

focus_notify.title: Notify
focus_notify.description: Native notification when a block ends.

focus_autoBreak.title: Auto break
focus_autoBreak.description: Start the break when a block ends.
